verdict.summary: The diff adds only src/slugify.mjs, so it stays inside src/. The file has a named export, slugify(text). The function converts the input to a string, lowercases it, replaces each run of characters outside [a-z0-9] with one hyphen, and then strips hyphens from the start and end. Tracing the required example: '  Hello, World!  ' lowercases to '  hello, world!  ', becomes '-hello-world-' after the hyphen replacement, and ends as 'hello-world'. That matches the expected output, so criterion:slugify is met. I found no defects in scope.
